frases.it: Buongiorno, signor Bianchi. La crema che ha ordinato per il trattamento è arrivata.
frases.es: Buenos días, señor Bianchi. La crema que encargó para el tratamiento ha llegado.
frases.en: Good morning, Mr. Bianchi. The cream you ordered for the treatment has arrived.

frases.it: Può ritirarla presso la nostra farmacia oggi dopo le sedici oppure domani mattina.
frases.es: Puede recogerla en nuestra farmacia hoy después de las cuatro de la tarde o mañana por la mañana.
frases.en: You can pick her up at our pharmacy today after 4: 00 in the afternoon or tomorrow morning.

frases.it: Il prezzo del prodotto è di 8,50 euro; la ricetta medica è già stata registrata nel sistema.
frases.es: El precio del producto es de 8,50 euros; la receta médica ya ha sido registrada en el sistema.
frases.en: The price of the product is €8.50; the medical prescription has already been registered in the system.
analisis: la ricetta medica è già stata registrata
the prescription has already been registered

frases.it: Se preferisce, possiamo tenere la confezione riservata fino a venerdì sera.
frases.es: Si lo prefiere, podemos guardar el envase reservado hasta el viernes por la noche.
frases.en: If you prefer, we can save the reserved package until Friday night.

frases.it: La farmacia è aperta regolarmente fino alle venti, ma domani chiude dalle tredici alle quindici per inventario.
frases.es: La farmacia está abierta normalmente hasta las ocho, pero mañana cierra de una a tres por inventario.
frases.en: The pharmacy is usually open until 8: 00, but tomorrow it closes from one to three per inventory.
analisis: chiude dalle tredici alle quindici per inventario
close from one to three per inventory

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: pharmacy notifications and customer services

bloques.pregunta: What product ordered by the customer has been received at the pharmacy?

opciones.texto: The cream for prescribed medical treatment.
opciones.explicacion: The message notifies: «La crema che ha ordinato per il trattamento è arrivata».

opciones.texto: A new package of sterilized couplings and gauze.
opciones.explicacion: The specific order was the treatment cream.

opciones.texto: A whole lot of stress drugs.
opciones.explicacion: Only the arrival of the cream in charge is confirmed.

bloques.pregunta: From what time range can the customer move on to withdraw their product today?

opciones.explicacion: The notice clearly states: «oggi dopo le sedici oppure domani mattina».

opciones.texto: Before 10: 00 in the morning, no exceptions.
opciones.explicacion: You can only pick up from 4: 00 today.
The collection is available from 4: 00 onwards.

bloques.pregunta: What is the amount that the customer should pay when withdrawing his purchase?

opciones.explicacion: The text points to the exact cost: «Il prezzo del prodotto è di 8,50 euro».
The price set in the message is €8,50.

opciones.texto: It is a free delivery covered entirely by the insurance.

bloques.pregunta: How long can they keep the order in reserve if the customer prefers it?

opciones.explicacion: The notification offers: «possiamo tenere la confezione riservata fino a venerdì sera».
It offers a collection margin until Friday at the end of the day.

opciones.texto: Únicamente durante las próximas dos horas hábiles.
opciones.explicacion: The agreed reservation period is extended until Friday.

bloques.pregunta: On what schedule will the pharmacy stop its attention to the public by inventory tomorrow?

opciones.texto: From 13: 00 to 15: 00 (one to three in the afternoon).
opciones.explicacion: The text warns: «chiude dalle tredici alle quindici per inventario».

opciones.texto: All day in the morning since morning opening.
opciones.explicacion: The inventory closure is only from two hours to noon.
In that afternoon strip, the pharmacy will be open normally.

bloques.pregunta: What tone and communicative style characterize this service message?

opciones.explicacion: It uses commercial courtesy formulas: «signor Bianchi», «ha ordinato», «Cordiali saluti».

opciones.texto: Informal, family and colloquial tone between close friends.
opciones.explicacion: It does not use unangry language but formal customer care guidelines.

opciones.texto: The amount of urgent claim for unpaid invoice.
opciones.explicacion: It's an ordinary product collection information notice.

intro: It includes formal commercial and pharmaceutical notification messages concerning orders, availability and hours of attention.
